units.source_text: 我放慢了脚步，准备尾随这个学生。

en.t: I slowed my steps, preparing to follow this student.

units.source_text: 走着走着，我竟觉得他的左肩稍倾斜的背影，似乎就是我的背影。

en.t: As I walked on, I somehow felt that his figure from behind, with his left shoulder slightly slanted, seemed to be my own.

units.source_text: 他远比我英俊，但他无疑是与我同样的孤独、同样的不幸、

en.t: He was far more handsome than I was, but without doubt he shared the same loneliness and the same unhappiness as me,

units.source_text: 同样从美的妄念中波同样的行为所驱使。

en.t: and was driven by the same impulse toward the same act, born from the same delusions about beauty.

units.source_text: 我尾随着他，不知不觉地产生了这样的感觉：

en.t: As I followed him, I unconsciously came to have this feeling:

units.source_text: 我仿佛预先看到了自己的行为。

en.t: it was as if I had seen my own actions in advance.
